title: Apollo Global Cayman Crossover Feeder II

expectedBrief.clientType: Non-US institutional investors (joint signatories), US tax-exempt, family offices
keyRequirements: Joint non-US institutional signers on W-8BEN-E with a single Chapter 4 / CRS election owner
Beneficial-ownership look-through at 10% up to four tiers, changeable without losing drafts
Digital Asset Custody hardware wallet attestation annex

metadataDistractor.why: Same jurisdiction and structure (Cayman master-feeder) but a different problem (MFN / FX tiers); must not outrank AND-2025-014.

expectedDelta.why: Identical requirement: one role owns the Chapter 4 / CRS election, co-signers attest; decoupled DocuSign anchors.
Same CRM and same prefill-then-confirm pattern; review Cayman-specific entity types.
Recursive repeater with ubo_threshold_pct exists, but there 10% applied only to high-risk exposure; here 10% applies to every investor, under Cayman rather than Luxembourg rules.
No historical case covers wallet-control proofs, multi-sig key-holder KYC, or on-chain screening.

expectedPitfalls: AND-2025-014 (Minh Nguyen, ALUMNI): two signers editing W-8BEN-E Part I / Part XXIX at once deadlocked Step 4 and blocked DocuSign — 9-day UAT slip.
AND-2025-051 (David Le, ALUMNI): changing the UBO threshold mid-flight requires a draft migration, or in-progress investors lose work.
AND-2025-029 (Sarah Tran): concurrent CRM-prefilled submissions can race past per-investor validation.

title: Bain Capital Tech Opportunities Parallel V

expectedBrief.clientType: US pension plans, endowments, US family offices (joint signatories), HNWIs
keyRequirements: ERISA 25% Benefit Plan Investor limit monitored on an aggregate basis across Main and Parallel
Joint family-office signers with one designated tax (W-9) signatory

expectedDelta.category: ERISA aggregate cap across parallel funds
expectedDelta.why: Same LPA covenant and late-closing pension rush; reuse the locked, idempotent pre-countersignature guard.
Prefill-then-confirm pattern carries over, but DealCloud entries, field names, and API differ from Affinity.

expectedDelta.category: Joint signatories and tax certification ownership
expectedDelta.why: Role-isolation and DocuSign anchor decoupling carry over; the tax form is W-9 for US family offices instead of W-8BEN-E.
No historical case collects per-owner QP representations for vehicles formed to invest.

expectedPitfalls: AND-2025-029 (Sarah Tran): four pension subscriptions in six minutes nearly pushed aggregate BPI to 28.4% because validation was per investor.
AND-2025-014 (Minh Nguyen, ALUMNI): two signatories editing tax certifications concurrently can deadlock the tax step.
